title: Group Meeting at Table with Papers, 1970s Indoor B&W Vintage Photo
description: A black and white snapshot capturing a group of six adults—three men and three women—gathered around a table laden with stacks of paperwork, forms, and books during an informal committee or volunteer meeting. The individuals are dressed in mid-to-late 1970s casual attire, featuring patterned button-down shirts, a striped polo, cardigan sweater, and iconic retro oversized eyeglasses. The cozy setting appears to be a residential or community space featuring a wood-paneled door in the background.
